title: Work-tape head bounds
statement: Let $C$ be a configuration of a machine with $m+k_D$ work tapes, and let $W,B$ be natural numbers. The head position of each of the first $m$ work tapes lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive, and the absolute value of the head position of each of the remaining $k_D$ tapes is at most $B$.
